mutations.name: land decides before taking the missing fix-proof read on the decided base
mutations.find: readIfUnread: async (ctx, headSha, base) => (reads.has(`${headSha}@${base}`) ? undefined : reread(ctx, headSha, base)),
kills: a PR reviewed on main whose MERGE record names no proof base (TP-4259) merges a kind outside the fix-proof gate on a skipped read on main taken before its first decision

mutations.name: an allow is never gated on a fix-proof that judged another base
kills: a stacked PR whose fix-proof was refused on the parent branch, retargeted to main with the same head (TP-4259) asks the owner instead of merging when the line on main is vacuous

a stacked PR whose fix-proof was refused on the parent branch, retargeted to main with the same head (TP-4259) merges nothing after a retarget when the parent run's clean line names no base, and gates as no-facts

mutations.name: an unverified re-read on the decided base clears the gate
mutations.find: if (standing.unverified !== undefined) return { unproven: `its fix-proof on ${base} is unverified: ${proofUnverifiedOf(standing)}` };
kills: a stacked PR whose fix-proof was refused on the parent branch, retargeted to main with the same head (TP-4259) asks the owner instead of merging when the line on main is an error

a stacked PR whose fix-proof was refused on the parent branch, retargeted to main with the same head (TP-4259) asks the owner instead of merging when the PR changes the fix-proof harness, whatever the line on main says

mutations.name: a clean re-read clears the gate whatever base its line names
kills: a PR reviewed on main whose MERGE record names no proof base (TP-4259) merges nothing on a recorded re-read on main whose clean line names no base, from a reader before TP-4259

mutations.name: a gate that cannot be read reads as skipped, which clears the base guard
mutations.find: if ("unreadable" in gate) return { kind: "error", reason: gate.unreadable };
mutations.replace: if ("unreadable" in gate) return { kind: "skipped", reason: gate.unreadable };
kills: a stacked PR whose fix-proof was refused on the parent branch, retargeted to main with the same head (TP-4259) asks the owner instead of merging when the re-read on main cannot read the fix/ PR's head branch, never reading it as skipped
